summary: 15 Java files written under lre/; all 51 requirements traced in result_codegen.json; gradlew build clean. Five items need human review.

issues.title: Safe large distance is 1000.0 m
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 requires odist/hdist/vdist to return 'a safe large distance' with no obstacle but gives no value.
issues.fix_directive: If the AUV sensor range implies a different value, set Sensor.SAFE_DISTANCE accordingly.

issues.title: LRE-DM5 no-obstacle defaults are mutually inconsistent
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 requires nsRelDist/ewRelDist to return zero with no obstacle while hdist must return a safe large distance; LRE-SF1 defines hdist from those accessors, so the two clauses conflict. The conflict propagates into LRE-OP5: zero relative position makes the naive CPA formula give cda=0, falsely enabling MOM->CAM.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm the intended no-obstacle value for nsRelDist/ewRelDist, or state that the distance functions are primitive rather than derived from the accessors. Implemented by giving odist/hdist/vdist an explicit no-obstacle branch and expanding cda^2 as hdist(cdyn)^2 + 2*tcpa*closingRate + tcpa^2*relSpeedSq, which is algebraically identical to the standard CPA distance but carries the hdist safe default through.

issues.title: Floor on relative speed keeps tcpa finite
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 does not define tcpa when the relative velocity is zero (division by zero).
issues.fix_directive: Replace CalcCPA.MIN_REL_SPEED_SQ (1e-6) with the intended degenerate-case handling if specified.

issues.title: CAM has no entry action
issues.raw: LRE-FR4 says CAM performs evasive manoeuvres, but LRE-DM7 restricts outputs to advVel/advHdng and no requirement states which value CAM should issue.
issues.fix_directive: Specify the evasive advVel/advHdng values for CAM entry. CAM retains two outgoing transitions (LRE-Beh17, LRE-Beh18) so it is not a sink.

issues.title: nat-typed indices carry a -1 sentinel
issues.raw: LRE-Var5/Var6 call cstc/cdyn natural numbers yet assign -1 for 'none'; Java int maps to RoboChart nat unconditionally, so -1 is not representable in the extracted model.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented as specified (-1), with all missing-data handling pushed into Sensor so no controller predicate tests the sentinel. Confirm this is the intended encoding.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> T2M -> M2M -> M2T -> verifiers).
